title: Wide entry vector growth policy
summary: Recover the 28-byte entry capacity calculation and unsigned growth guard at 0x49c050.
test_description: Compare the original thiscall routine with the recovered method for empty, aligned, unaligned, large, wrapped and negative signed byte differences, multiple requested counts, and large wrapped address differences; verify all vector fields and the FS head are unchanged.
known_limits: Only the growth policy is recovered; allocation and vector mutation are outside scope.
Address fields model the original 32-bit representation; malformed differences follow the observed 32-bit arithmetic.
